name: blaze-shield-lua
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Blaze Shield honours HP/SP drain bonuses and Hylozoist Card on every pillar hit. A worked example of Lua skill hooks.

settings.label: Drain bonuses work on Blaze Shield
settings.description: Cards and weapons that drain HP or SP on a hit (Moonlight Dagger, Hunter Fly, ...) also drain on each Blaze Shield pillar hit.

settings.label: Hylozoist Card works on Blaze Shield
settings.description: Its chance to turn a monster into a random one rolls on each pillar hit, not only on weapon attacks.

settings.label: Log every hit
settings.description: Writes each hit to the map server's log. For checking the mod works; leave it off.
